The '''Crystal Fields''' were an area located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]],<ref name="SWG:TCFM" /> in the northern portion of the [[Crystal Flats/Legends|Crystal Flats]] region.<ref name="SWG:CF">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=poi|Crystal Flats|Mustafar}}</ref> It was formed when the [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Mustafar suddenly shifted, causing the world to tear itself apart. The [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] sprouted up virtually over night while it should normally take millions of years to form on other worlds.<ref name="SWG:TCFM" /> These crystals gave its name to the entire Crystal Flats.<ref name="SWG:CF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Crystal Fields were a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TCFM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Crystal Fields were added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWG:TCFM" />
